examples: Match the app to your company colors.
how_to: Follow the steps shown: make a folder, write its theme.json, add art if you want.
It appears in the themes list with no restart.
Press SUBMIT A THEME to open the publish screen; your own theme folders are listed there. The local check refuses a theme that carries a script, stylesheet, svg or html, naming the file.

summary: design your own color theme and preview it before saving it.
